title: NEON wadeable-stream fish, three-pass electrofishing removal, RELEASE-2026: fish of 155 taxa per pass at 223 reaches on 23 NEON stream sites, 2016-2024
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Fish electrofishing, gill netting, and fyke netting counts (DP1.20107.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/s1e6-df79. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.20107.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-05
abstract: NEON's fish survey in wadeable streams: ten reaches of about 100 m per site, three fixed reaches fished by three-pass electrofishing removal and the others by a single pass, in spring and fall bouts. Every fish is identified (to species where possible) and up to 50-100 per taxon per pass are measured; the rest are bulk-counted. This table is the number of fish of each taxon per pass, with every taxon on every pass (national pool, 155 taxa). Reach-centre coordinates are as NEON publishes them.
samplingProtocol: Backpack (or two-unit) electrofishing of a ~100 m reach in an upstream direction; fixed reaches fished in three consecutive removal passes, random reaches in one; fish netted, identified, a subset measured and weighed, and released after the bout (NEON AOS fish sampling protocol, NEON.DOC.001295)
surveyEvidenceNote: fsh_fieldData lists every reach-bout (with samplingImpractical where it was not fished) and fsh_perPass every pass; a survey is a pass of a reach-bout with samplingImpractical blank. A pass with targetTaxaPresent = N is y = 0 for every taxon.
closureNote: occasion = removal pass within one reach-bout; passes are consecutive, almost all on one day (at most 3 days apart, asserted); period = bout (spring or fall, a few 'other'), indexed globally by first pass date
geographicCoverage: 23 NEON wadeable-stream sites in the continental USA, Alaska and Puerto Rico; reach-centre coordinates as published by NEON (WGS 84) in __units; latitude 18.1 to 68.7, longitude -149.2 to -66.8

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published by NEON (agency-published reach-centre coordinates with coordinateUncertaintyInMeters; NEON fuzzes species of concern to a higher rank rather than the coordinates); 4 reaches were re-surveyed by a few metres between bouts and __units carries the latest

covariateNote: obs_sampler_type electrofisher / two electrofishers; obs_ef_time_s = electrofisher operating seconds on the pass (effort, NA where not recorded); obs_water_temp_c and obs_habitat_type per pass as published; period_reach_type = fixed (three-pass) or random (one-pass) reach as NEON labels the reach-bout; period_reach_length_m = measured reach length (NA where not measured); obs_count_estimated = 1 where y includes a bulk count NEON marks 'estimated' (ruling 17), else 0.
notes: y = per-fish records plus bulk counts of the taxon on the pass. Taxa: 123 species (subspecies rolled up) and 32 records identified, or fuzzed by NEON, only to a higher rank, each its own taxon (E6); NEON 'sp.' and 'spp.' codes of one name merged; morphospecies counted under their genus or family code. Surveys: 2492 passes in 1275 reach-bouts; 556 reach-bouts sampling impractical have no rows; 26 filed by NEON as net-compromised, 5 other whose passes are not numbered 1..k and 1 with a pass marked targetTaxaPresent = Y but no fish records were dropped whole. Estimated counts (ruling 17, 2026-11-06): 23 reach-bouts carry a bulk count NEON marks estimated (13768 fish); they are kept, and obs_count_estimated = 1 on the 81 pass x taxon rows whose y includes one. Bulk counts with actualOrEstimated blank (before the field was recorded) are kept as counts, flag 0. Passes after the first are present only on fixed reaches, so a random reach-bout has one removal cell.

notShipped.lake surveys: gill net, mini-fyke net and shoreline electrofishing at the 5 lake sites (CRAM, LIRO, PRLA, PRPO, TOOK): other protocols
notShipped.net-compromised bouts: 26 reach-bouts NEON filed under an eventID ending .netCompromised (a block net failed; the passes after the failure are split from the bout)
notShipped.incomplete pass series: 5 other reach-bouts whose passes are not numbered 1..k; 1 reach-bouts with a pass marked targetTaxaPresent = Y but no fish records
notShipped.per-fish measurements: fsh_perFish lengths, weights, life stages, DELT and injury flags, voucher and DNA sample ids
